name: Cheese
desc: This is a chunk of cheese, it can be eaten

name: Grape
desc: This is a grape, once eaten it will provide a seed, it can also be used to create wines.

name: Tomato
desc: This is a tomato, it can be used as food and will provide seeds as well.

name: Fungus
desc: This is a chunk of fungus, it can be eaten by some creatures such as Kobolds and Goblins

name: Meat
desc: This is a chunk of meat, it can be eaten.

name: Cooked_Meat
desc: This is a chunk of meat, it can be eaten.

name: Javelin
desc: A light spear made for throwing. Units throw javelins at enemies up to 6 tiles away before closing in.

name: Throwing Axe
desc: A small balanced axe made for throwing. Units throw them at enemies up to 4 tiles away.

name: Fishing Rod
desc: For fishing shallow water (sardine, herring), rivers (trout, pike, salmon) and cave pools.

name: Fishing Net
desc: A small net for shrimp and anchovies in shallow water, and tropical fish in swamps.

name: Lobster Cage
desc: Set in deep water for lobsters.

name: Harpoon
desc: For the big fish of deep water: tuna, swordfish and shark.

name: Climbing Gear
desc: Pitons, hooks and a rope: the carrier can climb a cliff face onto a mountain top, or down one.

name: Iron Chains
desc: Heavy chains, made at the Forge. A dragon worn down takes three to bind, a great spider two (right-click it: Chain it down). One ties a captive person, harder to break than any rope.

name: Rock salt
desc: Rock salt. Carried, it keeps the food in the same bag four times longer; left on a stockpile, the food there. A lump keeps ten pieces for an hour, then it's used up. Double-click it in a bag to salt the carried food for good (eight times longer, four pieces a lump).

name: Athelas
desc: Kingsfoil: crushed into a poultice at a Doctor's stall it closes wounds and stops bleeding.

name: Feverfew
desc: A bitter little daisy: made into a tonic at a Doctor's stall it breaks a fever.

name: Milk thistle
desc: A purple thistle: made into a purge at a Doctor's stall it draws out poison, settles the stomach and sobers.

name: Athelas poultice
desc: Closes wounds (+80 health) and stops bleeding.

name: Feverfew tonic
desc: Breaks a fever and keeps it off for a while.

name: Thistle purge
desc: Draws out poison, settles food poisoning, sobers. Poured into poisoned food it neutralises some of the poison.

name: Soul stone
desc: A rare stone of the mountains. Used beside the body of the dead it takes their soul; beside a gargoyle of yours, it gives the soul a body of stone.

name: Dragon Egg
desc: A dragon's egg, warm to the touch. Carried off and laid down away from a nest, it will hatch into a dragon of your own.

name: Leather Bandage
desc: Soft strips of hide from the Leatherworks. Bound round a stump it cuts the bleeding a lot, but it doesn't stop it: fire or a poultice does.

name: Silk Bandage
desc: Spider silk wound into a dressing at the Leatherworks: it holds back more of a stump's bleeding than leather, but it doesn't stop it.

name: Leather Rope
desc: Plaited hide from the Leatherworks. A fair rope for tying a captive.

name: Plant Rope
desc: Rope twisted from log fibre at the Carpentry. It ties a captive, but a strong one may break it.

name: Silk Rope
desc: Spider silk laid into rope at the Leatherworks: light, and very hard to break.

name: Stake
desc: A pointed wooden stake. Driven into the ground beside a bound captive (their card: Stake here) and the rope tied to it, they hold as well as tied to a tree.

name: Rune Stone
desc: A gem cut with runes that holds mana. Carried, it tops up its bearer's magic weapons.

name: Torch
desc: A stick with a pitch-soaked rag at its head, from the Carpentry. Lit with flint and tinder when it's needed, it sears a bleeding stump shut (it hurts). Good for three searings.
